input.summary: Settled 28 of 29 controls (left_joy_up left as a question). Movement and camera controls (left_joy_down, left_stick, right_stick) bound to their dominant sip/puff patterns from history. Combat controls (right_bumper, right_trigger, left_bumper, left_trigger, B, X, Y) each bound to their clearest majority pattern, with right_trigger marked inferred since it tied with the joystick tilt that's reserved for movement here. D-pad switches (dpad_W, dpad_E, dpad_N, dpad_S) and menu controls (start, back) bound to leading historical inputs, with dpad_W and back marked inferred where the leading input was clear but the exact timing value was split across near-equal variants. The 12 unmapped keyboard/mouse controls (kb_a, kb_c, kb_e, kb_f, kb_f1, kb_h, kb_left_control, kb_left_shift, kb_q, kb_s, kb_w, kb_x, mouse_right_button) were left unbound rather than assigned, since Elden Ring's sourced control list has no documented function for them and the controller-equivalent controls already cover full gameplay.
